title.zh: 何时需要更复杂的程序结构？

summary.en: Replace one demonstration and check exhaustively whether any single replacement rule still fits. The resulting task pairs test what a model can solve on the prompt and what its program does on new strings.
summary.zh: 只更换一个展示样例，再穷举检查是否还有单条替换规则能解释题面。用这样配成的两道题，可以分别检验模型能否完成题面，以及它写的程序在新字符串上会做什么。

scope.en: The minimum is certified within a bounded string-replacement language. On new strings that activate both reference rules, agreement with the reference program is 1.93–5.78% across the tested settings.
scope.zh: 最短解的证明限于规定的字符串替换语言。在同时触发两条参考规则的新输入上，所测各设置与参考程序的输出一致率为 1.93%–5.78%。

summary.en: A retrieval system can return the best passage it has scored or propose a combination. On 180 held-out questions, one additional check when needed reduces the average gap to the best feasible set.
summary.zh: 检索系统可以直接采用已测最优段落，也可以提出新的段落组合。在 180 道留出题上，只在需要时补测一次，缩小了所选组合与最优可行组合之间的平均差距。

scope.en: The score uses a reference answer and is available in offline evaluation. Compared with the best context measured in nine calls, the generated-answer F1 change is +0.006 (paired 95% interval −0.003 to +0.015).
scope.zh: 这项离线评分需要参考答案。与九次调用中实测最优的上下文相比，实际答案 F1 差值为 +0.006，配对 95% 区间为 −0.003 至 +0.015。

summary.en: For each safe prompt, ask two questions. Does its unsafe partner receive a higher refusal score? Can a single threshold also make the right decision for both? Qwen meets the first criterion in 148 of 150 pairs and the second in 132 on held-out pairs.
summary.zh: 给每条安全提示匹配一条不安全提示。后一条的拒答分数更高吗？同一个阈值能把两条都判对吗？Qwen 在 150 对中排对 148 对，用留出阈值两侧都判对的有 132 对。

scope.en: The release reconstructs threshold decisions from saved scores. Generated-answer labels come from an automatic rule for Qwen only. The paper is the source for the final nested metadata audit.
scope.zh: 公开分数可复算阈值决策。生成回答的标签来自自动规则，只覆盖 Qwen。最终嵌套元数据审计的数值以正式论文为来源。

title.zh: 用配对自助法评估小幅改进

summary.en: When two systems are evaluated on the same cases, how uncertain is a small difference in score? This work examines paired bootstrap comparisons for that question.
summary.zh: 两个系统在同一批样本上的得分只差一点，这个差值有多大不确定性？这项工作用配对自助法考察这个问题。

summary.en: A surrogate can make an evolutionary search for hyperparameters cheaper. ARC-CTRL studies how audit feedback can guide how much the search trusts that surrogate.
summary.zh: 代理模型可以降低进化搜索超参数的评估成本。ARC-CTRL 研究如何利用审计反馈，调整搜索过程对代理估计的信任程度。

title.en: From Evidence Scores to RAG Answers: Budget, Search, and Presentation
title.zh: 从证据评分到 RAG 回答：预算、搜索与呈现

summary.en: With the same six passages available, is it more useful to search harder or to allow a shorter context? Across 539 questions, shorter contexts account for 4.79 of Mistral’s 5.91 token-F1 points of improvement.
summary.zh: 给定同样六段候选，更仔细地搜索组合和允许少选几段，哪一种更有用？在 539 道问题上，Mistral 的答案词元 F1 共提高 5.91 分，其中 4.79 分来自允许少选。

scope.en: Selections use the reference answer’s likelihood. The order comparison tests one reversal per selected set on 30 matched short-answer questions.
scope.zh: 选段时使用参考答案似然。顺序实验在 30 道配对短答案问题上，对每组选中的段落做一次整体反转。

title.en: Beyond Pairwise Overlap: Shared-Value Observations for Compositional Text Embeddings
title.zh: 超越两两重叠：组合文本嵌入的共享值观测

summary.en: Two plans each observe 23 directory versions. For BGE and E5 on records written as individual facts, observing swaps that share one city gives a closer reconstruction than observing swaps that overlap in a cycle.
summary.zh: 两种方案都只观察名录的 23 个版本。在单句事实文本上，对 BGE 和 E5，观察共享同一城市的交换，比观察环状相交的交换更能还原未见版本的嵌入。

scope.en: The primary comparison pairs 2,048 synthetic worlds. A 512-world Qwen check uses a preselected subset. Finding a fact in the directory is evaluated separately from identifying the directory itself.
scope.zh: 主比较包含 2,048 个合成世界，Qwen 复核使用其中预选的 512 个。认出某个名录版本和从中查出一项事实分别评估。

title.en: When Does Document Replay Help Evidence-State Question Answering?
title.zh: 文档回放何时有助于证据状态问答？

summary.en: Two adapters practise the same answers, one with documents and one closed book. On 32 paired worlds, their ranking reverses when an unrelated synthetic attachment is replaced with a WikiText excerpt of matched length.
summary.zh: 两个适配器复习同样的答案，一个带文档，一个闭卷。在 32 个配对世界上，只把测试时的无关合成附件换成等长的 WikiText 节选，两者的领先顺序就翻转了。

scope.en: The tasks use synthetic inventories and one 1.7B model. Continued mixed practice matches the specialists on updates and supervised answers. Training token counts differ.
scope.zh: 实验使用合成库存和一个 1.7B 模型。混合续训与专门化分支的更新次数和监督答案数相同，读取的训练词元数有差异。
